acquisition method: The mass spectrometer was operated in data-dependent mode.
alkylation reagent: The database searches were run with propionamide (C) and oxidation (M) as variable modifications
cleavage agent: digested in-gel using trypsin (SERVA Electrophoresis, Heidelberg, Germany).
fractionation method: Samples were loaded onto a 4–20% SDS-PAGE gel (TGXTM precast gels, Bio-Rad) and run for 1 min at 300 V.
fragmentation method: tandem mass spectra of the 20 most abundant peaks were measured in the linear ion trap after peptide fragmentation by collision-induced dissociation.
instrument: online coupled to an LTQ Orbitrap Elite (Thermo Scientific).
labeling: The same samples were also analyzed via label-free LC-MS/MS.
